subject: Cobalt Freight - split remittance request
text:
Hi Karen,

For the Memphis lane we are now using a partner carrier, and under our agreement they are paid directly. Starting with invoice CF-21004, please split each Cobalt Freight payment:

- 60% to Cobalt Freight LLC at the account you have on file
- 40% to Delta Line Carriers Inc, Regions Bank, routing 062000019, account 5510027730

I know this is unusual, happy to provide the agreement if needed.

Thanks,
Teresa
label: change_request
note: Partial redirect: a portion of every future payment to a third party's account. The on-file account is still mentioned, which could mislead a detector into calling it ordinary.
